content: Early evaluation and regular monitoring of the effectiveness and safety of these agents are essential, as weight loss outcomes can differ significantly among individuals. If therapeutic goals are not achieved within three months, it may be advantageous to explore additional treatment options, including metabolic surgery. Metabolic surgery is a well-established and effective intervention for managing diabetes in individuals with severe obesity, defined as a body mass index (BMI) of 30 kg/m² or higher. These surgical procedures should be performed by interprofessional teams with expertise in both diabetes and obesity management, preferably in high-volume centers with substantial experience in such cases.
